import ctypes
import sys

def assert_test():
    # Load the libraries in the correct order
    try:
        ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
        gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")
    except OSError as e:
        print(f"Error loading libraries: {e}")
        sys.exit(1)

    # Define the gsl_test function signature
    gsl.gsl_test.argtypes = [ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_char_p]
    gsl.gsl_test.restype = None

    # Test cases
    print("Running test cases...")

    # Test case 1: Passing test
    gsl.gsl_test(0, b"Test case 1: Passing test")

    # Test case 2: Failing test
    gsl.gsl_test(1, b"Test case 2: Failing test")

    # Test case 3: Edge case with empty description
    gsl.gsl_test(0, b"")

    # Test case 4: Edge case with long description
    long_description = b"A" * 100
    gsl.gsl_test(1, long_description)

    print("All test cases executed.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
